geographic_coverage: India-wide (national coverage across all States and UTs)
quality_notes: Primary source for national roads, railways, hospitals, fire stations, waterways, and settlements.
Must be downloaded once and split into thematic layers to prevent redundant transfers.
operational_use_restrictions: Governed by Open Database License (ODbL 1.0). Derivative databases must share-alike. Volunteered geographic information; density is high in urban centers and variable in rural forest tracts.
